title: Design System: Agwood Mill & Lumber — Stated Flat

paper-deep.purpose: Second light field; the Pending ground.

ink.purpose: Headings and body on light fields.

forest.purpose: THE ACTION COLOUR. Measured from the logo's fill green.

forest-hover.purpose: Action hover; darker so contrast rises.

forest-deep.purpose: The dark field, header and footer. The logo's outline ink.

russet.purpose: THE STATE COLOUR. Position, and named gaps.

on-deep-dim.purpose: Secondary text on the dark field.

on-deep-mark.purpose: The state colour on the dark field.

display.purpose: One hero line per page. Fraunces 500 at opsz 144, SOFT 0, WONK 0 — the wobble switched off.

headline.purpose: Statement headings and the value a statement resolves to. Fraunces 500 at opsz 72.

title.purpose: Wordmark and statement numerals. Fraunces 600 at opsz 40.

lede.purpose: The paragraph under a display line. Archivo 400.

body.purpose: Running prose and spec rows. Archivo 400.

label.purpose: Field eyebrows and Pending markers. Archivo 700, wide tracking. NOT monospace.

control.purpose: The action and nav links. Archivo 700.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: There are no shadows. Depth is the tonal step between fields and nothing else. A panel that casts a shadow is a card, and a card wants a grid.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Fields rise on entry. Start state under :root.js only; reduced motion reveals immediately.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Single column; statement numeral moves above its heading.

components.name: Field
components.description: SIGNATURE. A full-bleed band of one colour carrying exactly one statement. The colour change between consecutive fields is the only section division on the site. Tones: paper, deep, forest. The forest tone flips every child to reversed tokens.

components.name: Cell Row
components.description: SIGNATURE. Three cells on one field, each carrying a small state-colour label, a Fraunces argument, prose, and the fact the argument resolves to. Facts are bottom-aligned across the row. No icons, no cards, no borders around cells, no shadow, no radius, no per-cell background — one hairline between cells and nothing else. Never a fourth cell.
components.html:

components.name: Action
components.description: The single primary action. Forest fill, paper text, square. On the dark field it inverts to paper-on-forest-deep, because forest green on forest-deep is invisible.

components.name: Spec Row
components.description: Term/value pairs as a description list. An unknown is set in russet and says what to do instead of pretending to be data.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Reversed dim at rest on the dark header; the reversed state colour when it is the current page. Never green — green means you can do something, and being somewhere is not doing something.

components.name: Reach Map
components.description: SIGNATURE. Northern California from real boundary data, Ukiah marked, straight-line distances to seven reference towns computed from coordinates. Generated at build time. The towns are reference points, not customers. Never redraw the outline by hand.

components.name: Phone Display
components.description: SIGNATURE. The telephone number as the largest element on the page. The only way into the business, sized accordingly. Tabular figures.

narrative.overview: Each field states one thing the mill will do, and nothing else. The site is a stack of hard-edged full-bleed bands in the company's own two greens and its paper, each carrying exactly one statement. The statements are numbered because they are a genuine sequence of narrowings — one species, one channel, one place.
keyCharacteristics: One statement per field, never two and never a row of three.
The colour change between fields is the only section division.
Colour is structural: the two greens are measured out of the logo.
No ornament of any kind — no texture, pattern, generated material or imagery.
Green acts, russet locates; on the dark field both take reversed variants.
No shadows, no rounded corners, no monospace.
rules: Never draw a rule between two fields.
Green is only ever on something you can do.
Russet is only ever on where you are, or on a gap being named.
An unknown is demoted to body type so it cannot read as a held fact.
No sustainability or certification claim without a certificate in hand.
history: A prior direction generating drawn redwood grain (cathedral arches, grain bands, drawn placeholders) was built in full and rejected by the client on 2026-08-25 as feeling 'cheesy and poorly executed' after four rounds of geometry refinement. The finding was not that the grain was drawn badly but that ornament on a six-fact site reads as compensation. That vocabulary is dead and must not be reintroduced in softened form.
The client approved this direction as a merge: the field structure of one candidate with the numbered-statement content of another, singling out 'One species, run properly.' as the line that works.
